rules.statement: The proper course to adopt when a scheme of partition submitted by a Surveyor is found to be better than that submitted by the Commissioner is to remit the scheme to the Commissioner with a direction to modify it on the lines prepared by the Surveyor.
rules.supporting_quote: As was held in Hendrick v. Gimarahamine (2) where a scheme of partition submitted by a Surveyor is found to be better than that submitted by the Commissioner in the case, the proper course to adopt would be to remit the scheme to the Commissioner with a direction to him to modify the scheme on the lines prepared by the Surveyor.
